bio: Kottra is often called the unluckiest Orc in the Ironbands. It’s the Goblins: ever since she found her lucky knives, she’s always running into Goblins. Even in places where there shouldn’t be any Goblins! Too bad for them – her knives are wicked sharp, and she’s gotten really, really good with ‘em.
